text:
Maria Lopez: FYI — customer reported structured-mode streaming fails when payload contains apostrophes. Getting 'JSON parse error: unexpected EOF in string'. Repro below.

Devon Chen: Can you paste the raw request/response and any minimal repro? Streaming chunk boundaries often split escapes.

Maria Lopez: minimal repro (streaming; they used bash single quotes around payload):
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"mode":"structured","input":"O'Reilly\\nNew entry"}'
```
Note: the client wrapped the whole JSON in single quotes, so the apostrophe in O'Reilly breaks the shell quoting. Also our chunking can split inside an escaped sequence. Example of how server receives chunks:
```
chunk 1: {"reply":{"text":"O'
chunk 2: Reilly\\nNew entry"}}
```
That results in an incomplete string in chunk 1 and parse error on concat.

Samir Patel: Two things: 1) client-side bug — don't use single quotes around JSON in bash when payload contains apostrophes; either escape the apostrophe or use double quotes and escape inner quotes, or use --data-binary @file. 2) Server-side parser should buffer across chunks and treat incomplete string escapes as non-terminal until closing quote/escape resolved.

Ingrid Sørensen: Customer is on SDK v0.9 which uses naive framing. We should backport a quick fix that buffers up to N bytes or until an unescaped closing quote. I'll add regression test for split-escape sequences.

Devon Chen: Workaround for customer: send payload as file or base64 encode the input, or use JSON.stringify in node so shell quoting not required. I'll open internal ticket and propose SDK patch.

Maria Lopez: Filed internal: ENG-JSONSTREAM-312. Logs attached: ``error: JSON parse error: unexpected EOF in string at position 27`` with partial payload shown above. @Devon can you own short-term patch? I'll reply to customer with workaround and ask for SDK version.

support-bot: Ticket created #CS-5237, assigned to Devon Chen.

Devon Chen: On it; will add chunk-buffering heuristic and a CLI note in docs. ETA EOW :+1:

Maria Lopez: Thanks all. Closing loop once patch merged; customer notified of workaround.
